'''Tymps''' were omnivores native to [[Serat]]. Originating in the world's [[Forest/Legends|forests]], they were opportunistic, and adapted to life in [[Seratian]] [[City/Legends|cities]], raiding storehouses for [[Roti (food)|roti]] [[Grain/Legends|grain]]. Seratians' hunting of [[symer]]s&mdash;the only natural predator of tymps&mdash;resulted in a tymp population explosion that jeopardized local [[Farm/Legends|agriculture]].
